newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT- KB cuts CBR to reduce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- KB cuts CBR to reduce.

text.p: KB Securities said in a statement on Thursday it had downgraded shares in Belgian cement maker CBR to "reduce" from "accumulate" following a company meeting with analysts on Wednesday.

KB has four kinds of investment recommendations: buy, accumulate, reduce and sell. Reduce means that the brokerage thinks the share will underperform the Bel-20 index by up to five percent in the next 12 months.
Generale Bank earlier on Thursday said it cut CBR to sell from hold following the same analysts meeting.
As reasons for the downgrade, KB Securities cited flat bottom line earnings prospects in 1997, a lack of upside potential in Western Europe and a mixed outlook for Eastern Europe.

It also said CBR made a strategic mistake to invest in California, where its market share was only six percent compared to 42 percent in Belgium and said that CBR and its German parent Heidelberger Zement had lagged behind their competitors in their international diversification.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
